svg.title: Architecture

svg.text: Five floors of glass: every request walks down the tower

Vercel, Netlify or Railway forward the
relay domain to your panel domain.
TLS ends at the Cloudflare edge. The Worker
serves the panel, /sub links and the
VLESS and Trojan are terminated in the
Worker. With an upstream set, any protocol
Direct, or a country group per user:
first, next one if it fails.
no server to run: the whole stack lives on Cloudflare
